notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-10, cited below. Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939) (R2256, HyperWar, Campaign-III), says that on 10 September the XVII and XVIII Corps on the Fourteenth Army right crossed the San north and south of Przemyśl, forced the Polish 24th Infantry Division to withdraw eastward, and drove elements of the 11th Infantry Division into the fortress city. Kennedy does not say which of the two corps crossed north and which south, so both pins use the same city and qualifier.
